claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Nidec exits or deprioritizes strain-wave reducers (product line discontinued or absent from subsequent robotics showcases); upgrade when any humanoid/robot maker names FLEXWAVE adoption, or Nidec discloses precision-reducer capacity or revenue split in statutory filings.
claims.statement: Nidec Drive Technology (formerly Nidec-Shimpo, part of Nidec 6594.T) officially markets FLEXWAVE strain wave gear reducers for humanoid robot joints across six series, from component sets to integrated assemblies — making Nidec the second at-scale supplier candidate in this graph's strain-wave-gear chokepoint alongside Harmonic Drive Systems. This is a structural counterweight to the HDS ~85%-share narrative and an observable path for the HDS disproof condition (major humanoid adopting non-HDS reduction). Limits: vendor self-report product page; no humanoid maker named as FLEXWAVE customer, no capacity or revenue disclosure; catalog availability does not equal design wins.

sources.quote: The Next Generation Nidec FLEXWAVE high precision simple contained assembly and component sub-assembly gear reducers are the ideal choice for these types of applications.
High positional accuracy, zero backlash, low vibration, maximum torque capacity, as well as lightweight and compactness are a necessity for drive components for such robot structures.
